evidence: Matches the Build system label, modifies cmake/module/CheckCXXFeatures.cmake, CI configurations (.github/workflows/ci.yml, ci/test/*), and raises the minimum compiler version.
rationale: Bumping the minimum GCC version to 13 modernizes the build toolchain and enables std::format, but carries no external deadline and is reasonably deferrable. The author states that 'only C++20 `std::format` will become available, but this bump should also pave the way for C++23'.
